alt: 兩個家庭在客廳茶敘，年輕伴侶與雙方父母平等交談、分享茶點。
scene_prompt: Meaning: 門當戶對 describes two families whose economic and social backgrounds are well matched when their children marry. Show a contemporary engagement tea gathering in a welcoming home: the bride- and groom-to-be sit together smiling while both sets of parents meet around the same tea table. The two family groups are presented with comparable, modestly comfortable dress and homes, both greeting each other warmly, sharing tea and planning together; use balanced composition and similar furnishing quality on both sides to show equal footing, not wealth competition. Natural respectful posture and smiles; six adults total with realistic anatomy, exactly two arms and legs each, hands correctly holding tea cups or resting naturally. No readable text or status symbols.
